text.p: Zurich Insurance Group said it had successfully concluded its takeover of Norwegian insurer Protector Forsikring ASA.

"Zurich has binding acceptances from shareholders who together hold 99.5 percent of the share capital and will, in compliance with Norwegian law, acquire the remaining shares from minority shareholders," it said in a statement.

Shareholders will get 230 Norwegian crowns per share, reflecting a total value of 550 million crowns. Zurich will retain sole ownership of Protector upon completion of the transaction and delist Protector's shares from the Oslo bourse.
Protector is a specialist insurer with emphasis on international marine insurance and energy business as well as on Norwegian commercial and industrial market segments.
It reported 1996 gross premium income of around 725 million crowns.
